report.honesty: Simulation on a published H100 SXM profile. Peak-bandwidth copy time is an upper bound, not a predicted wall clock. On identical exact prefixes, Tiny Footprint matches production prefix-cache residency. I.title: Tiny Footprint · live GPU chat-stack memory + latency (nvidia-smi)

report.memoryClassNote: Measured on NVIDIA GeForce GTX 860M via nvidia-smi / cuMemAlloc / cuMemcpyHtoD. This GeForce uses GDDR device memory; datacenter HBM is the operator analogue for the same duplicated-resident-state problem — not identical silicon. Latency is materialization path, not frontier LLM decode.

latency.honesty: Wall-clock cuMemcpyHtoD + cuCtxSynchronize on this GPU for with/without Tiny Footprint materialization. Not frontier LLM decode TTFT/TPS.

strategy.proposition: A lot of cost is paying rent on duplicated resident state so the same organizational pattern can be served many times.
implications: pack more concurrent work per box
buy less memory per unit of AI service

latency.honesty: Wall-clock cuMemcpyHtoD + cuCtxSynchronize on this GPU for with/without Tiny Footprint materialization. Not frontier LLM decode TTFT/TPS.

I.honesty: Measured on NVIDIA GeForce GTX 860M via nvidia-smi / cuMemAlloc / cuMemcpyHtoD. This GeForce uses GDDR device memory; datacenter HBM is the operator analogue for the same duplicated-resident-state problem — not identical silicon. Latency is materialization path, not frontier LLM decode.
I.interpretation: Live on NVIDIA GeForce GTX 860M: cuMemAlloc 81.4%; nvidia-smi 72.8%; density 11.85×; turn p50 without 43.15 ms → with Tiny Footprint 4.50 ms (9.60× speedup).

experiments.title: Tiny Footprint · real local-GPU LLM infer + train (DirectML/CUDA)

J.title: Tiny Footprint · real local-GPU LLM infer + train (DirectML/CUDA)

report.honesty: Real local-GPU causal-LM forward/generate + AdamW train microbench on NVIDIA GeForce GTX 860M via directml. Tiny Footprint = shared system-prefix KV reuse + single optimizer; without = duplicated full-prefix prefill per session + multiple optimizer copies. Not frontier decode TTFT on a hosted API; DirectML/CUDA on laptop GeForce ≠ datacenter HBM proof.

J.honesty: Real local-GPU causal-LM forward/generate + AdamW train microbench on NVIDIA GeForce GTX 860M via directml. Tiny Footprint = shared system-prefix KV reuse + single optimizer; without = duplicated full-prefix prefill per session + multiple optimizer copies. Not frontier decode TTFT on a hosted API; DirectML/CUDA on laptop GeForce ≠ datacenter HBM proof.
J.interpretation: Real LLM on NVIDIA GeForce GTX 860M: prefill 1.80×, generate 1.37×, train step 1.17× (with vs without Tiny Footprint).

results.honesty: Tiny Gateway · Rhyming Templates / Tiny Footprint: holographic rhyme = repeating · self-similar · self-correcting · recursive (four-pillar gate). Signature-bucket routing + recursive context-fold hooks + byte-touch joule PROXY are companion meters (K/L/M) — not semantic retrieval, not a KV-compression product, not wall-socket energy, not solar-synced clocks. In-process lab + (A) HtoD allocation proxy on GTX 860M and (B) REAL local-GPU LLM lab (sshleifer/tiny-gpt2 via torch-directml) measuring shared-prefix infer + AdamW train with vs without Tiny Footprint — those GPU meters are prefix-reuse, not rhyme proofs. Proxy ≠ model forward. DirectML on laptop GeForce ≠ datacenter HBM / hosted frontier API. Φ_EGS design grammar only. Engine pin is data-gated.
